name: Dreycey Albin
bio: ML engineer with roots in computational biology, focused on bridging research and production systems. I design and validate traditional machine learning and deep learning models, build experimentation frameworks, and ship low-latency inference pipelines. At Microsoft Azure, I work at the intersection of modeling and distributed systems on Resource Central, the central ML platform in the control plane, serving all regions and handling more than 1 million requests per day.
